en: Vintage sepia postcard with two photographic views of an outdoor restaurant/beer‑garden set among large trees. The left image shows rows of tables with white tablecloths and folding chairs, with a few staff or guests standing. The right image shows the veranda of a villa‑like building with ornate iron columns and railings, where many people pose around tables. Handwritten cursive text in German covers parts of the front. Printed captions identify the place as the "Drei‑Eichen" (Three Oaks) restaurant of Kovács, and the printer as being in Hermannstadt. The reverse side has the word "LEVELEZŐ‑LAP" (Hungarian for postcard), a Hungarian postage stamp marked "MAGYAR KIR. POSTA" and a circular postmark, along with an address written in German.
